# FDG9004

> DO design aggregate components so they can be used after very simple initialization. If some initialization is necessary, the exception resulting from not having the component initialized should clearly explain what needs to be done.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: what counts as very simple initialization depends on the scenarios, and whether an exception message explains what needs to be done is judgment. FDG2016 states the first half for all APIs.
